sources.summary: Greek architect Elia Zenghelis, one of the co-founders of international architecture firm OMA, has passed away at the age of 89. Elia Zenghelis, who was also an influential architectural educator and director of Gigantes Zenghelis Architects, died on August 30 2026. Further details have not been made public.
